interventions.body:
REGISTRAR

WHAT I FOUND
**mri_hospital**: MRI performed at OLVG (Amsterdam) on 10 December 2024. The MRI demonstrated a PI-RADS v2.1 score 5 lesion in the left transition zone, measuring approximately 12 mm, showing restricted diffusion and hypervascularity, with no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion identified. Clinical T stage was cT1c.
**pathology_report**: Histological examination revealed adenocarcinoma of the prostate with a Gleason score of 3+3 and an ISUP grade group of 1. Perineural invasion was absent. The tumour location was confined to the transition zone, left.
**previous_notes**: Notes from May 17, 2024, documented a PSA level of 4.4 ng/mL, noting a rise from baseline and the subsequent referral to urology.
**family_history**: No family history of hereditary cancer syndromes was recorded.
**psa_trend**: PSA values recorded are 1.6 ng/mL in May 2022, 4.4 ng/mL in September 2023, and 5.9 ng/mL in January 2025.
**laboratory_results**: The most recent PSA was 5.9 ng/mL on 13 December 2024. Free PSA was 1.57 ng/mL (27%), and eGFR was >60 mL/min/1.73m2.

WHAT IS NOT RECORDED
The specific staging or local extension assessment from the radiology report is not explicitly detailed beyond the cT1c classification. The precise rate of PSA increase over the last documented interval is not quantified. Family history regarding hereditary cancer syndromes is not recorded. Additional findings in the laboratory results beyond the listed parameters are not recorded.

WHAT THIS SUPPORTS
